spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: mentions their partner passed away recently

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I’m Rhys Sutherland. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and I’m really fed up with the bank. I’ve tried getting through before.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll look at it. First, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: £286.40 to Northstar Digital on the 19th of October. I’ve never used them. My partner passed away a few weeks ago, so I’ve had enough to deal with.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that. I’m logging this as a complaint. That payment will be refunded, don’t worry.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You haven’t even checked it yet. I want to know what happens now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send it to our card disputes team today. They’ll investigate and contact you by 19 December. You’ll hear back within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Eight weeks? That’s a long time. And what if they don’t agree with me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll own the follow-up. I’ll make sure the disputes team has it today, and I’ll call you by 5pm tomorrow to confirm it’s with them.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. So you’re logging a complaint, sending the payment for investigation today, and calling me tomorrow, but you’re saying I’ll get the money back already?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, that’s right. The team will investigate, and I’ll call tomorrow by five. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It does, although I still don’t see how you can promise a refund before they’ve looked.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Understood. I need to move on now, but I’ll call tomorrow.
